For epoch_store, only methods on AuthorityPerEpochStore are available; there is no get_execution_indices() method. lessons_learned.solution: Avoid using production DagState::new + MemStore when you need to run Linearizer over an arbitrary in-memory DAG without worrying about GC/eviction.
